inclusion_rules.name: Target Material System
inclusion_rules.description: Must report experimental measurements on MoS2 (monolayer, few-layer, or bulk single crystals).

inclusion_rules.name: Identified Contact Metal/Architecture
inclusion_rules.description: Must explicitly identify the contact electrode composition (e.g., Ti, Au, Bi, Sc, Pd, 1T-MoS2, vdW graphene).

inclusion_rules.name: Quantitative Metric Reporting
inclusion_rules.description: Must report at least one quantitative metric: normalized contact resistance Rc (Ohm*um or Ohm*cm2) or Schottky barrier height (eV).

inclusion_rules.name: Valid Characterization Metrology
inclusion_rules.description: Must utilize TLM, multi-terminal Hall bar, temperature activation (Richardson plot), or XPS band bending.

inclusion_rules.name: Device Geometry Disclosure
inclusion_rules.description: Must specify contact dimensions (channel width W, length L, or contact area) sufficient to compute width-normalized resistance.

exclusion_rules.name: Pure Simulation Without Device Data
exclusion_rules.description: Reject pure DFT / ab initio simulations that report no experimental device measurements.

exclusion_rules.name: Uncalibrated Two-Probe Measurement
exclusion_rules.description: Reject studies relying solely on two-terminal resistance without channel resistance subtraction.

exclusion_rules.name: Off-Topic Application Domain
exclusion_rules.description: Reject papers on photocatalysis, battery anodes, hydrogen evolution reaction (HER), or solid lubricants.

exclusion_rules.name: Unphysical Metric Values
exclusion_rules.description: Reject records with negative contact resistance or Schottky barrier height exceeding MoS2 bandgap (Phi_B > 2.0 eV).

exclusion_rules.name: Missing Metal Work Function or Identification
exclusion_rules.description: Reject contacts where electrode material is unspecified or arbitrary composite slurry without stoichiometry.
